name: Warren Commission Report
description: The 888-page report (with 26 volumes of evidence) concluding Oswald acted alone in killing President Kennedy. Both the foundational official record and, for critics, the foundational text to be picked apart — beginning the modern era of official-report skepticism.

name: Zapruder Film
description: Abraham Zapruder's 26-second 8mm home movie of the Kennedy assassination — the most analysed piece of film in history, whose frame 313 and head-motion physics have powered arguments on all sides for decades.

name: JFK Assassination Records Releases
description: Under the 1992 JFK Records Act — passed in response to Oliver Stone's film — millions of pages have been progressively declassified, with final tranches in the 2020s. The releases have enriched context (CIA monitoring of Oswald) without documenting a plot, and each remaining redaction sustains the story.
